verdict.rationale: The only on-point evidence is the onramp doc stating that Stripe itself handles KYC verifications and sanctions screening for onramp customers inside its hosted or embedded checkout flow. Connected-account recipients link wallets through the Express Dashboard, but nothing documents KYC/KYB clearance for that path. Missing for 10: documented programmatic KYC/KYB endpoints for customers and recipients, KYB for business counterparties, verification-status gating before payouts or sends, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, customer and recipient onboarding is programmatic — documented KYC/KYB endpoints or flows that clear a counterparty for sending and receiving before money moves

citations.quote: We also handle all regulatory requirements, know your customer (KYC) verifications, and sanctions screening.
Use the Embedded onramp to let your customers check out directly in your website.
After a user links a crypto wallet in the Express Dashboard, they immediately see a new USDC balance on their connected account.
